gap.$description: dimension used by the tabs component for gap (MarsUI md bar item gap Space/8xl 26px; the gap carries all spacing now that items have zero inline padding).

width.$description: dimension used by the tabs component for the tablist divider width (the Tab_nav bar has no stroke; the hook stays for consumers to opt back in — material3 keeps its hairline via its override).

color.$description: color used by the tabs component for divider color.
